headline: Lil Durk’s Dad: OTF Jam’s Alleged Lies Hurt Me More Than Durk’s Actions
body: DJ Akademiks reports Lil Durk’s father shared his emotional reaction to OTF Jam’s testimony in the ongoing trial, claiming the rapper allegedly lied about Durk’s contributions. The father described the experience as stomach-turning, highlighting the deep personal impact of the testimony. This development adds tension to the high-profile legal battle involving the rapper’s family.

caption:
Lil Durk’s dad says watching OTF Jam take the stand and allegedly lie about Durk’s actions made him physically ill. The father emphasized the emotional toll after Durk’s extensive support for him. With closing arguments starting, fans and legal teams are watching closely for the next moves in this high-stakes trial.
